en: Nah, there's too much stuff at my house. Besides, the rental place is close by, and it's fine as long as I can rent it whenever I want.

So you try not to buy unnecessary things?
You never do any impulse shopping?
Nope! I guess I'm not much of a materialist. I'd much rather spend my money on an enjoyable experience.
Ah, so you're one of those people.
Going to the theater is nice, too. Films nowadays are really impressive, especially on the big screen.
Yeah, but I don't really watch action movies, so my TV at home is fine. And that way I can just sit back and relax.
That's for sure. Sitting in a movie theater chair for two hours can get pretty tiring.
Yeah! And at home I can rewind something if I wind up dozing off.
I've been there. I went to see a movie after work once and wound up passing out. Maybe viewing at home is better.
That's a shame. We have so many theaters here in Tokyo. Since you live here, you should take more advantage of them.
If you live in the suburbs, there are times when you want to watch a movie, but it's not showing anywhere nearby.
Well, I like being able to rent something on the spot when I feel like watching a movie.
Going to the theater requires making plans, and I don't like doing that.
I suppose theaters have their pros and cons, just like anything.
I want to hear your thoughts on romance.
Romance? Like in what sense?
What requirements do you have for men?
Let's see. Well, he can't be a smoker. I seriously don't get the appeal.
Why is smoking a deal breaker?
Because it makes your clothes stink, and you have to wash them right away. It's such a hassle.
I see. I never really thought about that. Is it so bad that you can't stand it?
Could you stand someone who reeked like garbage, Kiryu-san?
I suppose not. It's only natural to have an aversion to something like that.
See? It's pretty gross.
I'll have to be more careful from now on.
Deal with it. It's just a smell. Is it that much different than the smell of liquor?
It's not only the smell, but it's rough on the lungs too! To non-smokers, it's practically poison gas.
Guys know the harm secondhand smoke can cause, but they still smoke anyway. It's like, really?
Is it really that harsh to non-smokers? I'll have to be more mindful of that in the future.
You don't understand. Back in my day, smoking was a sign of maturity.
When I was a kid, we were all into the image of movie stars and the like smoking cigarettes.
Maybe that's how things used to be in the old days, but it's not cool at all now.
Smokers are totally oblivious to others' needs. It's not about whether it's cool to smoke or not.
So then what's the problem?
Anything else? That can't be the only thing.
Well, I like a guy who's got game.
Game?
Yeah. Someone with charm, who naturally draws people to him. I like guys like that.
Do you like to be in that inner circle, too? I wouldn't have taken you to be such a fan girl.
Well, so what if I am? I wouldn't go out with someone if he's not attractive to others.
I guess you have a point.
How do you like a guy to behave?
How indeed? Hmm.
My heart really starts racing if a guy beckons me over.
Beckons you over?
Yeah, like, when a guy waves his hand to be all, "C'mere, you." I'll just run right on over!
Wow. That's a new one.
Don't you ever feel that way, Kiryu-san? If a girl did a cute little wave from afar, as if to say, "Come over here, you!" wouldn't you want to?
Yeah. I'd probably get the wrong idea and assume she was interested in me.
See? That's what I'm talking about.
Hm. I think I understand.
No. If she needs something, she can come to me.
That's not what I mean at all! Geez! Don't you know anything about how flirting works?
That seems demeaning, don't you think?
Nooo, he's taking charge! It's way cool. And super hot, too!
Alright, but wouldn't you want to be treated more like his equal?
Nah, I want to be doted on! Someone who really takes care of me, you know?
Do you like your guys to be in a certain age range?
Age range, huh? Well, I'm not into younger guys, so I guess they can be my age or older.
I see. So age isn't that important to you.
That's surprising. I thought you'd be more picky about that sort of thing.
I mean, isn't it more important that our personalities mesh well? Age really has nothing to do with that.
I guess you're right. You can't judge someone just on how old they are.
See, I like people who aren't overly picky! It's good that you're so understanding, Kiryu-san.
Thank you. I think.
It still matters. A big age gap brings with it a big difference in values. Could you date someone from your parents' generation? I'd say no.
But what's wrong with having different values? I find that rather fascinating about people.
Though I may not get along well with someone who's as nitpicky as you, Kiryu-san.
Well then.
Why don't you like younger guys?
I guess because I have a kid brother and sister? I just think I've had enough of dealing with younger people.
So you want to connect with someone your age or older. That makes sense.
Mind telling me about yourself?
What do you want to know?
Do you have any siblings?
Yeah, a younger brother and sister. I'm the oldest.
I'm envious. I bet that's a fun family.
Are you an only child, Kiryu-san?
Yeah. But I was raised with other children, who were like siblings to me. A boy my age, and a girl three years younger.
Oh, I wish I had siblings the same age as me! Tell me, what's that like?
Hey, I thought I was the one asking questions.
You don't seem like it. You give off the impression of being an only child. Actually, more like the youngest child.
Yeah, I get that a lot. But it's only 'cause I'm here with you, Kiryu-san.
Well, I'm the oldest child at home. So when I go out, I like to be the one that's doted on for a change.
Okay, I see. Then I'll dote on you all you want.
You really mean it!? Yaaay!
...I might regret this.
Hmm. I do like that my legs are long.
Oh? How long are they?
85 centimeters!
And how tall are you?
160, on the dot.
So your legs are longer than your torso? That is pretty impressive.
I know, right? I'm pretty proud of it.
Got any special talents?
Cleaning up rooms, I guess? When I see someone else's messy room, I just have this urge to clean it all up.
Nice. Girls who are good at domestic chores are pretty desirable.
Right? And since I'm against buying things people don't need, I can save you money too!
That's weird. You shouldn't have to pick up someone else's mess.
Well, my house is tiny, so I've picked up a lot of tricks to make the most out of a small space.
In fact, it's gotten to the point where my mom really relies on me to take care of things like that.
It's good you're taking care of your parents.
Oh, I'm good at hailing a taxi!
A taxi? What do you mean by that?
Around here, there are a lot of drivers who won't pick up hostesses. We're too much trouble for them or something.
Really? That's not right.
Yeah, but I have a secret move I use that guarantees a cab driver will stop for me!
Heh. So what's your move?
I wave a 10,000 yen note at them! That usually gets them to stop.
That's ridiculous. You know we're only allowed to charge for what's on the meter, right?
You know, I've been wondering about something.
What!? I can't hear you!
I said, what are your measurements?
Why would you need to know that?
Isn't that something people usually want to know?
Okay... They're, uh, 100, 100, 100.
Maybe I shouldn't have asked that.
Uh, never mind. That was a rude question.
Look, I'm working on making my boobs bigger, okay? I'll let you know once I'm done with that.
Bigger? By doing what?
You know, drinking soy milk, eating cabbage, swimming... Lots of things!
Wow, you're really committed, aren't you?
Are you a dom or a sub?
What? Neither, I guess.
Well, if you had to pick one or the other, which would it be?
Ugh, I can't stand men who self-identify themselves like that. They sexually harass a girl and then are all, "It's because I'm a dom." I mean, come on.
I can see you don't like this conversation topic at all.
Umm... Usually just my sweats.
Me too. Sweats are the best for hanging around the house and just lounging around.
You really think so, too? Guess we're agreed, then!
...This subject did not go the way I thought it would.
Anyways, I don't really care about what guys wear to bed.
That's pretty tomboyish of you. I'd have figured you wore proper sleepwear.
Well, I practice dancing in my room a lot, so I like to wear stuff that's easy to move around in.
I work out in sweats myself.
Yeah, see? Having to change is such a hassle, and it's not like I dance enough to sweat either.
Hey there. %s-san? It's Riku.
Riku? What's up?
If y'got the time now, wanna go on a date?
A date? Sure, I don't mind.
I'll be waitin' at the <Color:255,200,200,255>police box near the central intersection on Nagasu Boulevard.<Color:Default>
The police box near the central intersection on Nagasu Boulevard. Got it.
I'll be waitin'! Make sure y'come! <Color:7>⑮<Color:Default>
Hello, %s-san? This is Kaguya.
Oh, hey, Kaguya. Ya need somethin'?
Saejima-san, would you like to go on a date with me?
You have time, don't you?
Just 'cause you're free doesn't mean I am. But heck, alright.
Okay! I'll be waiting <Color:255,200,200,255>in front of Bridie, at the Tsukasa Street intersection<Color:Default>.
Bridie, at the Tsukasa Street intersection? Got it.
I'll be waiting for you! Do please hurry! <Color:7>⑮<Color:Default>
Hey there, %s-san? It's Honoka.
Oh, Honoka-chan. What is it?
Do ya have some time right now? Wanna go on a date with me?
Whoa, would you look at that? I'm free now. An invitation from you takes top priority.
Well, don't skip out on your work now! I'll wait for ya at <Color:255,200,200,255>Iwao Bridge<Color:Default>.
Iwao Bridge? Sure thing. I'll be right there.
Alright then. Ya'd better come! <Color:7>⑮<Color:Default>
Hello. %s-san? This is Shion.
Shion-chan! What's going on? Is everything okay?
I just felt like seeing you, Shinada-san. Would you care to go on a date now?
A date!? Absolutely!
Wonderful! Okay then, I'll be waiting for you at <Color:255,200,200,255>the base of the TV Tower<Color:Default>.
Under the TV Tower! Got it! I'll be right there!
Don't keep me waiting too long. Please come! <Color:7>⑮<Color:Default>
Hey, %s-san? It's Hinata.
Hinata? What's up?
Do you have some free time right now? I kind of want to see you.
Sure, that's fine.
Woohoo! Okay, I'll be <Color:255,200,200,255>outside Club SEGA at Theater Square<Color:Default>.
Outside Club SEGA at Theater Square. Okay, I'll be there as soon as I can.
I'll be waiting! Please come! <Color:7>⑮<Color:Default>
Hey there, guys. Could I talk to you all about something?
Some of you know this already, but in addition to my primary business of being a moneylender, I also run a cabaret club called Elise.
Oh man, for real? Sweet. I wish I could make bank at my day job and have a side-gig, too.
Well, the truth is, business isn't so great. I may have to shut the club down soon.
So what did you want to talk to us about?
I need to find girls who are ready and willing to work at Elise at a moment's notice.
But with the recession, there's no one to hire. We can't find any girls in or around Kamurocho who fit the bill.
So you're up a shit creek then.
I'd heard rumors, but man, that's rough. I heard lots of folks are leaving Tokyo to look for work in Nagoya, too.
And that's exactly my point, Shinada-san.
Wait, what'd I say?
If there are no top-tier hostesses to find in Kamurocho, then we need to get them from somewhere else.
My plan is to scout the whole country, and snag the number one hostess in each of the big cities.
Good one.
You've put a lot of thought into this, I see.
But if that's your plan, why aren't you out there busting your ass scouting right now?
Well, I can't exactly scour the whole country by myself, you know? The club would go kaput before I made anywhere near enough progress.
So, I need your help.
Say what now?

Just hear me out! Kiryu-san can take <Color:255,200,200,255>Fukuoka<Color:Default>, and Saejima-san can do <Color:255,200,200,255>Sapporo<Color:Default>. Shinada-san, you have <Color:255,200,200,255>Nagoya<Color:Default>, and I'll do <Color:255,200,200,255>Osaka<Color:Default>. We've all spent time in those places, right?
